originalPrompt:
Build a Microsoft Excel (Cloud) integration for VoiceOS using Composio.

Use Composio-managed OAuth2 to connect a Microsoft 365 account.

For the initial version, expose only these two Composio tools:
- EXCEL_GET_WORKBOOK
- EXCEL_GET_RANGE

Do not expose any other tools.

Use the Composio API key provided during integration setup. Return structured JSON containing the workbook information or requested cell values.

Handle missing, expired, or revoked authentication with clear error messages.

Use native VoiceOS result cards to display workbook information and Excel range data.

Do not build an additional AI agent. VoiceOS Agent Mode will handle tool selection and responses.

Focus on making authentication and these two tools work correctly. Additional tools will be added later.
